subject: Coordinating AE/SE + IT for NovaShield demo — windows, fallback, and recording
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo scheduling for NovaShield — aligning AE/SE/IT windows

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for signing up and trying Redwood. I pulled together a very short plan so we can get the right people on the call (AE + SE + your IT/security) and keep it under 45 minutes. Quick ask: can you add your IT contact (if different from you) so we can get their availability?

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Wed 8/19 10:00–10:45 (preferred; overlap with east coast at 13:00)
- Thu 8/20 08:00–08:45 (early PST slot)
- Thu 8/20 13:00–13:45 (afternoon slot)

If IT can only join a subset, we can run a 25–30m customer-facing product run with AE/SE and do a follow-up technical deep-dive with your IT team.

I attached a short runbook with the demo outline and a checklist for IT (network/firewall notes, recording policy).

- Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: nova_demo_runbook.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lily Zhao <lily.z@novashield.com>, security@novashield.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for NovaShield — aligning AE/SE/IT windows

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — I'm available for the Wed 8/19 10:00 PDT slot. Adding Lily (IT Security) to loop. She will need the short checklist (firewall + allowed endpoints) and confirmation on whether the session will be recorded. If recording is required by compliance we'll need a data-retention note.

Also, heads up — Lily prefers a compact agenda: 20m customer product overview, 20m SE-technical Q&A. If IT can't make the first slot we can do the overview and follow with a technical deep-dive next week.

Samir
Head of Platform Engineering — NovaShield
samir@novashield.com | +1 (617) 444-2210

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>, Lily Zhao <lily.z@novashield.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for NovaShield — aligning AE/SE/IT windows

Thanks, Priyom — mirrored here so we can lock SE + AE assignments. Alex, can you cover the 20m technical Q&A and prepare a very short checklist for Lily (endpoints/ports and whether the demo will call any external telemetry)?

Suggested run format based on Samir's note:
- 0–5m quick intros and goals (Priyom)
- 5–25m product overview and screenshots (AE-led)
- 25–45m SE deep-dive + live example (Alex)

Fallback plan if Lily can't join: run 0–25m overview; schedule a 30m technical follow-up next week with Alex + Lily.

Soojin, I see a calendar conflict for me 8/19 10:00 PDT — can you confirm availability to cover AE portion if I need to step out?

-Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>, Lily Zhao <lily.z@novashield.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for NovaShield — aligning AE/SE/IT windows

Quick update — I have a conflict at 8/19 10:00 PDT (standup moved). I can cover 8/20 08:00–08:45 PDT or 8/20 13:00–13:45 PDT. Alex, are either of those OK for you as SE? If so I'll propose the calendar invite and add a brief note that the session will be recorded (unless compliance objects).

Also attaching a short calendar invite template (we'll include the runbook and the checklist).

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics

-Soojin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lily Zhao <lily.z@novashield.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for NovaShield — aligning AE/SE/IT windows

Soojin — thanks for the heads up. 8/20 13:00 PDT works for us (that's 16:00 EDT). Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Please confirm whether the session will be recorded and where the recording will be stored.
2) Attaching our IT vetting spreadsheet — can your SE fill the "Network/Ports" tab before the call so Lily can triage any firewall requests quickly?

Attaching: it-vetting.xlsx

If those are OK, please send the updated invite and we'll accept.

-Samir

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novashield.com>, Lily Zhao <lily.z@novashield.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Redwood demo — Fri 8/20 13:00 PDT / 16:00 EDT

Samir / Lily — thanks, confirmed. Per Samir's asks:
- We will record the session for internal review only; recording link will be placed in our shared Drive folder and retained for 30 days unless you specify otherwise.
- I filled the "Network/Ports" tab in the attached vetting sheet with the minimal endpoints and ports the demo will touch (no external telemetry; all traffic is to redwood.ai domains).

Calendar invite attached and sent (see calendar-invite.ics). Attendees: Priyom Das (AE), Soojin Lee (SE - primary), Jasmine Liu (SE backup), Alex Martinez (SE - host), Samir Patel (NovaShield), Lily Zhao (NovaShield IT).

Looking forward — Alex
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: it-vetting.xlsx, calendar-invite.ics
